significance: A Shiva temple at Tharuvana in the Wayanad hills, some 800 m above sea level, which also houses Arayil Bhagavathy, Durga, Nandi, Ayyappa and Ganapathi. Its name means the place where the axe fell.
story: Shiva is said to have hurled his axe at Krishna during their quarrel over Banasura's kingdom; where it fell, Parashurama built this temple.
